qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unassailable ~71% global market share in semiconductor vacuum valves. Valves represent <1% of wafer fabrication equipment cost but are mission-critical (valve failure destroys entire wafer runs), creating extreme spec-in switching costs for semicap OEMs (ASML, Applied Materials, Lam Research). Consistently defends 30-35% EBITDA margins and >26% GAAP ROIC across semiconductor cycles despite Swiss franc strength.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global monopoly (~71% share) in mission-critical vacuum valves for semiconductor manufacturing. Beneficiary of AI-driven node transitions (increasing vacuum process steps) and global fab reshoring. Pristine net cash balance sheet, >99% multi-year FCF conversion, and industry-leading returns on capital. [5-10Y g: semicap vacuum valve & service volume 6.5% + price/spec-in mix 1.5% + margin expansion 0.5% + capital return 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: VAT Group commands ~71% global market share in semiconductor vacuum valves with over 3x the share of its nearest competitor. 4-year financial data confirms median GAAP ROIC of 27.8%, operating ROIC >70%, and multi-year Owner FCF conversion of 99.2%. Intra-cycle EPS moderation in 2023-2025 reflects normal WFE digestion rather than moat erosion. Balance sheet is in a net cash position (CHF 141M cash vs CHF 45M LT debt) with interest coverage >70x.
